explanation: Presente perfecto: <has/have> + participio pasado. Se elimina la referencia temporal específica.

correct: The cake was eaten by the dog.
explanation: Voz pasiva: objeto + <was/were> + participio pasado + <by> + agente.

correct: She said that she was tired.
explanation: Estilo indirecto: se retrocede el tiempo verbal (<am> → <was>) y se cambian los pronombres.
Los adjetivos de 3 o más sílabas usan <more> + adjetivo para el comparativo.
Pasado continuo: <was/were> + verbo-ing. Muestra una acción en progreso en el pasado.
Los adjetivos cortos forman el superlativo con <the> + adjetivo + <-est>.

correct: I am going to study English.
explanation: Futuro con <going to>: sujeto + <am/is/are going to> + verbo base.

correct: He has not finished his homework.
explanation: Presente perfecto negativo: <has not> (hasn't) + participio pasado.
Preguntas en pasado continuo: se invierte <were> y el sujeto.

source: When I was young, I played every day.
correct: I used to play every day.
When I was young, I used to play every day.
hint: Use <used to> + base verb for past habits
explanation: <Used to> + verbo base describe hábitos pasados que ya no ocurren.
Pasado continuo: <was/were> + verbo-ing para una acción en progreso en el pasado.

source: I visit my grandmother every Sunday.
explanation: Futuro con <will>: sujeto + <will> + verbo base.
Los adjetivos cortos forman el comparativo con adjetivo + <-er>: <fast> → <faster>.
Los adjetivos cortos forman el superlativo con <the> + adjetivo + <-est>: <old> → <the oldest>.

correct: He said that he liked chocolate.
hint: Shift present simple to past simple
explanation: Estilo indirecto: <like> → <liked>, <I> → <he>.
Pasado continuo: <were> + verbo-ing para sujetos en plural.

correct: She is going to buy a new phone.
She's going to buy a new phone.
explanation: Futuro con <going to>: sujeto + <is/are going to> + verbo base.
Los adjetivos largos usan <more> + adjetivo: <difficult> → <more difficult>.

correct: She said that she could swim.
explanation: Estilo indirecto: <can> → <could>, <I> → <she>.
Presente perfecto: <have> + participio pasado. Se eliminan los marcadores temporales específicos.

correct: She will work at the hospital.
explanation: Futuro con <will>: sujeto + <will> + verbo base.
Superlativo irregular: <good> → <the best>.
Pasado continuo: <was> + verbo-ing.

hint: Double the final consonant before adding <-er>
explanation: Los adjetivos cortos terminados en consonante-vocal-consonante duplican la última letra: <big> → <bigger>.

prompt: Change to negative in past simple
correct: She didn't go to the party.
She did not go to the party.
explanation: Pasado simple negativo: <didn't> + verbo base. <went> → <didn't go>.
